tutorials.title: FIRE WYVERN
tutorials.summary: A two-legged dragon whose wings are its arms: build it from a gesture line and simple forms, then add wings, legs, spikes, scales, shading and a fire breath. Twelve steps; the reference shows the drawing at step 5 of 12.

steps.title: Basic construction
steps.text: Gesture line from head to tail tip, then ovals for chest and hips.

steps.title: Head and skull
steps.text: Wedge skull with a long, narrow snout.

steps.title: Neck
steps.text: Connect head to chest with an S-curve; keep it thick where it meets the body.

steps.title: Body structure
steps.text: Join chest and hip ovals; mark the spine on top.

steps.title: Wings
steps.text: Wyvern wings ARE the arms: draw the arm bones first, then long finger bones fanning out.

steps.title: Arms and legs
steps.text: Strong digitigrade legs with three forward toes.

steps.title: Tail
steps.text: Taper the tail smoothly; let it counterbalance the head.

steps.title: Horns and spikes
steps.text: Add a row of spikes down the spine, smallest at the tail.

steps.title: Facial details
steps.text: Narrow eyes, heavy brow, smoke curling from the nostrils.

steps.title: Scales
steps.text: Big plates on the belly, small scales on joints.

steps.title: Shading
steps.text: Pick a light source; shade the underside and the inner wing.

steps.title: Fire effects and final details
steps.text: Draw flame as flowing S-shapes leaving the mouth, brightest near the jaw.

tutorials.title: SPHERE OF LIGHT
tutorials.summary: Draw ORB’s basic form: a sphere lit from one side, with core shadow, cast shadow, blended values and a highlight. The video is a 50-second DEMO ANIMATION generated in code to test the player — not recorded tutorial footage.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Draw a light circle with your whole arm, not your wrist. Add a faint horizontal and vertical center line so you can judge symmetry.

steps.title: Light source & terminator
steps.text: Decide where the light comes from — here, top left. Draw the terminator: a curved line where light turns into shadow, wrapping around the form opposite the light.

steps.title: Core & cast shadow
steps.text: Block in the core shadow as a crescent on the side away from the light. Add the cast shadow on the ground, darkest right under the sphere and softer as it moves away.

steps.title: Blend the values
steps.text: Shade from light to dark in smooth, overlapping layers. Keep the darkest values just past the terminator, not at the very edge.

steps.title: Highlight & reflected light
steps.text: Lift out a small highlight where the light hits directly. Lighten the shadow edge slightly to show light bouncing back from the ground. That keeps the sphere round.

tutorials.title: DRAGON HEAD BASICS
tutorials.summary: Build a dragon head from simple shapes you can reuse for any species.

steps.title: Skull block
steps.text: Draw a circle for the cranium and a long box for the snout, angled slightly down.

steps.title: Jaw line
steps.text: Hang the lower jaw under the snout as a narrower wedge that hinges just below the eye.

steps.title: Brow & eye
steps.text: Place the eye where snout meets skull. Draw a heavy brow ridge over it for a fierce look.

steps.title: Horns
steps.text: Sweep two horns back from the top of the skull, following the curve of the head.

steps.title: Nostrils & teeth
steps.text: Add nostrils near the snout tip and a row of uneven teeth along the jaw line.

steps.title: Scale pattern
steps.text: Suggest scales in a few areas only — the brow, the snout and the jaw — instead of everywhere.

steps.title: Line weight
steps.text: Go over your final lines, pressing harder on shadow sides and under overlaps.

steps.title: Limbs
steps.text: Front legs lion-like, back legs bent like a cat’s.

steps.title: Wings
steps.text: Fold the wings half-open so they frame the head.

steps.title: Head
steps.text: Angular skull, swept-back horns, glowing eye sockets.

steps.title: Shadow wisps
steps.text: Let tendrils of darkness peel off the wing edges and tail.

steps.title: Rim light
steps.text: Keep the body dark; outline the edges with a thin bright rim of light.

steps.title: Final contrast
steps.text: Push blacks darker and add small sharp highlights on horns and claws.

tutorials.title: ZOMBIE DRAGON
tutorials.summary: The final creature: charcoal scales, exposed bone, torn wings and crimson fire.

steps.title: Silhouette
steps.text: Design a jagged, broken silhouette: torn wing membranes and a hunched spine.

steps.title: Anatomy first
steps.text: Draw the full healthy skeleton lightly so the decay sits on real anatomy.

steps.title: Exposed bone
steps.text: Open the ribs and one side of the jaw; draw bone with smooth, pale planes.

steps.title: Charcoal scales
steps.text: Cover the rest in dark, cracked charcoal scales, larger on the back.

steps.title: Torn wings
steps.text: Rip holes in the membranes; keep the finger bones intact.

steps.title: Crimson fire
steps.text: Crimson flames leak from the ribs and mouth — brightest at the source.

steps.title: Lighting
steps.text: Let the fire light the bones from inside; everything else stays dark.

steps.title: Atmosphere
steps.text: Finish with drifting embers and ash around the creature.
